subject: Air freight quote request: MUC to MEX
body:
Hello,

Our buyer in Mexico City, MX, is importing furniture samples from us in Germany, and we are arranging the flight for their import. Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from MUC to MEX and confirm the expected arrival date?

The import shipment consists of 9 pieces, with a gross weight of 1046 kg and a total volume of 6.70 cbm. The goods will be ready on 2026-11-26, and we will deliver them to MUC ourselves.

Please quote an all-in price in EUR and attach your offer as a PDF to your reply, as our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new air freight quote for a specified shipment from MUC to MEX.
